# AtomicMoveNotSupportedException

**Class** · `ironwood.nio.file.AtomicMoveNotSupportedException`

```java
public class AtomicMoveNotSupportedException extends FileSystemException
```

**Extends:** [`FileSystemException`](FileSystemException.md)

Signals that a move cannot be performed with the guarantee its caller
selected: an atomic rename across file systems, or an exclusive
(no-replace) rename on a host or file system that cannot supply one. The
move has changed nothing.
